seed.description: random seed: another number is another landscape

octaves.description: noise layers: more is finer detail and slower

scale.description: wavelength of the largest hills; unit: m

height.description: how high the hills go (amplitude); unit: m

offset.description: raises the whole terrain; unit: m

lacunarity.description: frequency multiplier from one layer to the next

gain.description: amplitude multiplier from one layer to the next

ridged.description: how much of sharp ridges to mix in

warp.description: domain warp: bends the noise so hills look less regular; unit: m

erosion.description: damps detail on steep slopes (smooth slopes, detailed valleys), like erosion

strength.description: how deep the gullies are; unit: m

scale.description: spacing of the coarsest gullies; each layer halves it; unit: m

octaves.description: gully layers: finer gullies branch off the coarser ones

detail.description: lower keeps fine gullies to steep slopes only

valley.description: height of the valley floors: below it gentle slopes fade into valleys; unit: m

peak.description: height of the peaks: above it gentle slopes fade into sharp tops; unit: m

gullies.description: erosion gullies carved into the noise (branching, evaluated per point without simulation); unset has none

spline.description: the spline the ground follows (its coordinates are the terrain's local ones); content path of a spline asset (no extension)

position.description: moves the spline by this much first; unit: m

width.description: width flattened along the path; unset follows the cross-section (a road is its surface plus shoulders); unit: m

offset.description: ground height relative to the path (slightly below a road surface); unit: m

falloff.description: blends back to the ground over this many meters beyond the width; unit: m

mode.description: conform cuts and fills, carve only cuts (cuttings, river beds), fill only raises (embankments)

splines.description: roads, rail beds and rivers the ground follows: flattened along each spline after the features, before the strokes

anyOf.description: content path of a material asset (no extension)

material.description: material of the ground; unset uses the default material; content path of a material asset (no extension)

uvScale.description: automatic UVs: one texture repeat per this many meters; unit: m

features.description: vector features: { type: 'flatten', points: [[x, z], …], height, falloff, strength } flattens a polygon (roads, plazas, foundations)

strokes.description: sculpt strokes in order: { op: 'raise' | 'lower' | 'flatten' | 'smooth', x, z, radius, strength, height }
